title: recording/document detect() match URL-shaped strings by file extension, so a valid YouTube/Zoom URL whose text ends in .mp3/.mp4 is routed to the local-path recording adapter ahead of the strict media adapters
evidence: buildSourceRegistry order recording, document, whatsapp, youtube, onair, zoom-recording, url. detectSource('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ&x=a.mp3') -> recording; detectSource('https://zoom.us/rec/share/AbCdEf123456.mp4') -> recording. recording.fetch would then try to read that string as a local path. Pinned by test 'KNOWN (ISS-SOURCESREG-001)'.
fix_direction: Out of this unit's scope (changes legacy adapters or their precedence): make recording/document detect() refuse strings starting with a URL scheme, or place the strict media adapters first. Needs owner choice because legacy ordering was required to stay unchanged.

title: Look-alike http(s) URLs (wrong host, userinfo, subdomain spoof) fall through to the generic url adapter, which fetches them; the strictness lives only in the new adapters
evidence: Routing table test: 'https://www.youtube.com.evil.tld/watch?v=...' routes to url exactly as before the change (legacy route identical). Whether the url adapter's fetcher is SSRF-guarded is a composition-root matter (guarded-fetch.ts exists).
fix_direction: None in this unit; ensure the composition root wires createGuardedFetcher into the url adapter.
